apps.label: Add or remove apps
apps.description: Install or uninstall applications from the ZZ catalog

update.label: Update
update.description: Update ZZ, the system, and developer tools

update.all.label: Packages and tools
update.all.description: Run every installed package manager and tool updater: dnf, flatpak, brew, npm, .NET, and Claude Code

update.zz.label: ZZ
update.zz.description: Fast-forward ~/.zz and reapply the current plan from saved selections

update.cleanup.label: Clean up unused packages
update.cleanup.description: Remove unused DNF and Flatpak packages

update.one.label: One updater
update.one.description: Run a single package manager or tool updater

update.one.dnf.label: DNF
update.one.dnf.description: Stage Fedora package updates for an offline upgrade

update.one.dotnet.label: .NET
update.one.dotnet.description: Update supported .NET SDK channels and installed global tools

desktop.label: Desktop
desktop.description: The compositor and the desktop shell

desktop.edit-niri.label: Edit Niri overrides
desktop.edit-niri.description: Open ~/.config/niri/local.kdl, the personal override file Niri loads last, and check the config when the editor closes
desktop.edit-niri.action: ${EDITOR:-nano} ~/.config/niri/local.kdl; niri validate || read -rsn 1 -p 'Press any key to close.'

desktop.pick-window.label: Pick a window
desktop.pick-window.description: Click a window to print its app id and title, the facts a window rule matches on

desktop.outputs.label: Outputs
desktop.outputs.description: List the connected outputs with their modes and positions

desktop.restart-shell.label: Restart shell
desktop.restart-shell.description: Restart the desktop shell service; the bar and launcher return in a moment

setup.label: Setup
setup.description: One-time configuration: AI agent, SSH, certificates, defaults

setup.agent.label: AI agent
setup.agent.description: Launch the default AI agent or choose which one that is
setup.agent.when: command -v claude || command -v codex || command -v opencode

setup.ssh.label: SSH access
setup.ssh.description: Key-only SSH access to this machine

setup.ssh.setup.label: Set up SSH access
setup.ssh.setup.description: Authorize a public key from GitHub or by pasting it, start the OpenSSH server, and turn password logins off

setup.ssh.status.label: SSH status
setup.ssh.status.description: Show the server state, the authorized keys, and whether password logins are off

setup.ssh.remove.label: Remove SSH access
setup.ssh.remove.description: Disable the OpenSSH server and drop the password-login restriction; asks before removing authorized keys

setup.dotnet.label: .NET dev certificate
setup.dotnet.description: The ASP.NET Core HTTPS development certificate

setup.dotnet.devcert-status.label: Certificate status
setup.dotnet.devcert-status.description: Show the ASP.NET Core dev certificate and browser import state

setup.dotnet.devcert-create.label: Create certificate
setup.dotnet.devcert-create.description: Generate the ASP.NET Core dev certificate and trust it in browsers

setup.defaults.label: Reset default apps
setup.defaults.description: Set file types, the terminal, and the browser back to the ZZ picks

setup.refresh.label: Reset a config to default
setup.refresh.description: Replace a user-owned config with the current ZZ default

troubleshoot.doctor.label: Run checks
troubleshoot.doctor.description: Run desktop readiness and post-install checks

troubleshoot.crash.label: Crashes
troubleshoot.crash.description: Core dumps and the crash notifications that offer an AI diagnosis
troubleshoot.crash.when: command -v claude || command -v codex || command -v opencode

troubleshoot.crash.list.label: Recent crashes
troubleshoot.crash.list.description: List the core dumps systemd-coredump keeps

troubleshoot.crash.diagnose.label: Diagnose the latest crash
troubleshoot.crash.diagnose.description: Hand the most recent core dump to the default AI agent in a terminal

troubleshoot.crash.capture.label: Toggle crash capture
troubleshoot.crash.capture.description: Turn the crash notifications on or off for every program

troubleshoot.crash.muted.label: Muted programs
troubleshoot.crash.muted.description: List the programs whose crashes no longer notify

troubleshoot.logs.label: Logs
troubleshoot.logs.description: Installer, compositor, shell, and system logs

troubleshoot.logs.installer.label: Installer log
troubleshoot.logs.installer.description: Show the last lines of the latest installer log

troubleshoot.logs.installer-follow.label: Follow installer log
troubleshoot.logs.installer-follow.description: Keep printing the latest installer log as it grows

troubleshoot.logs.niri.label: Compositor log
troubleshoot.logs.niri.description: Show the last lines of the Niri session log

troubleshoot.logs.shell.label: Shell log
troubleshoot.logs.shell.description: Show the last lines of the shell log, where QML and plugin errors land

troubleshoot.logs.boot-errors.label: Boot errors
troubleshoot.logs.boot-errors.description: Errors the system journal recorded since boot

troubleshoot.rescan-plugins.label: Rescan plugins
troubleshoot.rescan-plugins.description: Discover shell plugins added or changed under the plugins directory

troubleshoot.first-run.label: Re-run first-login setup
troubleshoot.first-run.description: Run the idempotent first-login desktop setup again

troubleshoot.debug.label: Create debug bundle
troubleshoot.debug.description: Create a local sanitized debug bundle

learn.label: Learn
learn.description: Keybindings and documentation for the pieces of this desktop

learn.keybindings.label: Keybindings
learn.keybindings.description: Every keybinding, searchable; pick one to run it
learn.keybindings.action: dms ipc call plugins toggle zzKeybindings | grep -q TOGGLE_SUCCESS || niri msg action show-hotkey-overlay

learn.zz.label: ZZ
learn.zz.description: The ZZ repository, its docs, and the zz command reference

learn.niri.label: Niri
learn.niri.description: The Niri wiki: configuration, window rules, and keybindings
